repair_contract.required_change: Allocate and own the proxy logical-slot vector lazily for TARGET_VERIFY only. Stock EXTEND, prefill, ordinary decode, model load, and CUDA-graph setup must not reserve a proxy vector or the 8,192-slot proxy bank. Preserve native allocator-owned vectors, distinct stock/proxy ownership, accepted-prefix move/free, request reuse, padded-row inertness, and the existing five converted layers.
required_tests: A stock EXTEND fixture proves zero proxy allocation and leaves allocator capacity unchanged.
A TARGET_VERIFY fixture allocates exactly its logical rows from the live batch-tree allocator and proves disjoint stock/proxy vectors.
Accepted and rejected TARGET_VERIFY rows move/free exactly once and ordinary post-accept decode remains stock.
The prior 8,192-slot exhaustion geometry is reproduced before the repair and passes after it.

requirements: Use a new artifact root and read all deadlines and the current bench connection identity from a new director readmission binding.
Do not retain the expired 2026-07-26T06:52:00Z deadline or the prior artifact root.
Keep one bounded durable owner, atomic claim/release, source installation hash, typed terminal, and warm release.

readmission_gate: A later director turn may open one new claim window only after the repair terminal passes, the new entrypoint and exact start command are hash-bound, the bench is available, and the remaining project reservation and lifecycle fit the measured run plus terminal/release margin.
